grading_contract.schedule: all 24 authored cases; 12 mapping and 12 retrieval; no success-only exclusion
grading_contract.mapping_comparable: exact concept set, or exact coarse metric plus whether mapping is qualified
grading_contract.mapping_qualified: candidate status resolved; baseline parse_fhir returned a row
grading_contract.mapping_dimensions: separate declared status/unit/method/property/specimen checks and coverage; baseline lacks these outputs
grading_contract.retrieval: exact unordered relevant observation-ID set at k=5, plus precision/recall; no answer-style grading
grading_contract.support: every returned ID and source/value/unit/date/span/availability/report field must equal its scoped observation
grading_contract.scope: exact returned scope equals captured view; leakage is any unknown/out-of-scope ID or future event/availability
grading_contract.abstention: completed empty output only; errors do not earn abstention credit
grading_contract.lexical: separate unfiltered token-overlap comparator, without ontology expansion or advice/injection policy
grading_contract.time: latency is a local observation, not a controlled performance benchmark

limitations: 24 authored development cases, not held-out generalization or clinical validation.
Baseline mapping is coarse metric_key/parse_fhir; missing formal dimensions are reported separately.
Baseline retrieval is actual offline route/tool evidence, not a historical ranked retrieval API.
Plain lexical comparator deliberately has no ontology expansion or unsafe-query policy.
Scope IDs differ by source bundle; bounds and fixture source content are held constant.
Follow-up fixes after these outcomes are development tuning; preserve initial output.
